verdict.rationale: Fin exposes an API and an official MCP server, so the question of scoped agent credentials applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents issuing scoped, permission-limited, or least-privilege API tokens. The MCP docs only say agents can "securely access" Intercom data, which is adjacent and does not describe credential scoping.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
